{"answer":{"baseline_summary":{"launch":"February 10","channels":["email","web","social"],"assets":["overview","demo"]},"recommendation":"Channel Calendar for February 10 Launch:

Pre-Launch (Feb 3–9):
• Feb 5 – Email: Send teaser/invite featuring the overview asset to build anticipation.
• Feb 7 – Web: Update landing page with overview content and placeholder for demo.
• Feb 5, 7, 9 – Social: Publish countdown/teaser posts using overview snippets.

Launch Day (Feb 10):
• Email: Distribute launch announcement with overview asset and link to demo.
• Web: Activate homepage banner and feature section highlighting overview + demo.
• Social: Post launch-day announcements across all platforms, embedding demo clip and overview highlights.

Post-Launch (Feb 11–16; pause Feb 17):
• Feb 11 – Web: Publish blog post or resource update centered on the demo.
• Feb 12 – Email: Follow-up send to non-openers with demo highlight.
• Feb 14 – Email: Deep-dive newsletter focusing on demo use cases.
• Feb 11, 13, 14, 16 – Social: Share demo highlights, quick tips, and engagement posts.
• Feb 17 – Pause all promotional messaging due to local holiday (per regional marketing lead guidance).

Post-Holiday (Feb 18+):
• Resume email drip and social cadence.
• Maintain web placement of overview and demo assets.
• Evaluate engagement data to refine messaging frequency.","quality_notes":["Pause all promotional activity on February 17 to respect the local holiday.","Ensure demo assets are optimized for mobile viewing on social and web channels.","Confirm email list segmentation to avoid fatiguing recipients during the pre-launch and post
